run_generate_cifar10_data: run the script to generate fake cifar10 binary batch files and label metadata
run_generate_cifar100_data: run the script to generate fake cifar100 binary batch files and label metadata
generate_cifar10_batch: generate a single cifar10 batch with random images and labels written to a binary file
generate_cifar100_batch: generate a single cifar100 batch with random images, fine labels, and coarse labels
run_main: run the CLI entry point to generate both cifar10 and cifar100 fake test data
